title: Use the current A5 T6 conditional composition owner while quarantining the stale T5 synthesis wrapper
question: Does a current A5 verifier provide a clean executable Sector-A composition for the QFT crosswalk even though the older T5 capstone wrapper retains historical claim aliases?
method: Run the canonical A5 T6 conditional-composition verifier with a fresh temporary output path.
Check the primary and non-importing independent lanes, their branch and mass-fork agreement, and the immutable T5 bundle digest.
Compare its explicit non-closure boundary with the stale T5 synthesis wrapper recorded in EXP-000981 before using either package as a QFT production-owner input.
finding: The current A5 T6 conditional-composition package passes fresh primary 22/22 and independent 13/13 lanes, integrated 35/35, with exact branch agreement, mass-fork separation 0.005 versus 0.26000000000947494031, and immutable T5 bundle digest verification. Its theorem is conditional composition of the full-production PDE branch and scalar continuum branch; it explicitly excludes a parameter-identical constructive QFT, full Class-II Gibbs measure, infinite volume, phase transition, BCC selection and T7. The older A5 T5 synthesis wrapper remains independently non-executable because its historical aliases fail before result creation. Therefore the T6 package is the current executable Sector-A composition owner, while the T5 wrapper is quarantined and must not be used to certify the QFT bridge.
decision_reason: This preserves the strongest fresh evidence without silently repairing or promoting a stale package. The QFT route may use A5 T6 only as a conditional PDE/static branch; it still cannot supply R-192 heat_root_incidence, root filtration, conditional replicas, raw-current spatial intertwiner or the production q-ledger.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing package-reconciliation evidence. It does not close A5 beyond its registered conditional T6 scope, does not choose physical dynamics, does not identify a stochastic production heat/root owner, and does not close A6/A7/A13, Sector-A physical closure, Pre-A, physical-empty, thermodynamic or real-time limits.
next_action: Use the finite F_ref stochastic-quantization candidate only as a comparison dynamics. Search or construct a separately hash-pinned A1 production heat/root owner satisfying every R-192 slot; keep the old T5 wrapper quarantined until a dedicated path-and-bundle revalidation package is authorized.
